request.description:
This API endpoint allows you to hand over a partner card vehicle. The HTTP POST request should be sent to {{BaseUrlCore}}/api/partnercard/partnercardvehiclehandover.

The request should include a raw body with the following parameters:
- handoverSequence (optional): A numerical value representing the handover sequence.
- customerCode: A string representing the customer code.
- cardNo (optional): A numerical value representing the card number.
- startDate: A string representing the start date.
- endDate: A string representing the end date.
- paginationFilter:
  - currentPage: A numerical value representing the current page.
  - pageSize: A numerical value representing the page size.

The response to the request will be in JSON format with the following structure:
- data: An array containing objects with the following properties:
  - handOverSequence: A numerical value representing the handover sequence.
  - handOverStatusName: A string representing the handover status name.
  - oldCustomerCode: A string representing the old customer code.
  - newCustomerCode: A string representing the new customer code.
  - oldCustomerName: A string representing the old customer name.
  - newCustomerName: A string representing the new customer name.
  - startDate: A string representing the start date.
  - additionDate: A string representing the addition date.
  - additionUser: A string representing the user who made the addition.
- success: A boolean value indicating the success status of the request.
- statusCode: A numerical value representing the status code of the response.
- extraParameters: An empty object.
- paginationFilter:
  - pageSize: A numerical value representing the page size.
  - currentPage: A numerical value representing the current page.
  - count: A numerical value representing the total count.

To print the number of items in the data object in the incoming response, you can access the length of the "data" array in the response.
